category_config.v2_contract: Estimator-v2 code must load selected_sets from this file; do not duplicate category strings or infer replacements from leaderboard scores.

constraint: No labels, sample score placeholders, removed reference layers, external facility lists, or Overture geometry columns were read. The provided ACS tract geometry and Overture bbox centers were used only for spatial assignment to official sample IDs.

recommendation.decision: Retain the existing exact fire and EMS station categories and the canonical school list. Exclude emergency_medicine from EMS because it is not an ambulance/EMS station category; exclude dance, driving, music, cosmetology, flight and other specialty schools from the school numerator. Use alternate-category/name evidence and the reported tract-zero sensitivity for review; do not tune these definitions on LB scores.
recommendation.hospitals: excluded per organizer methodology; category and name hits are reported but not facilities
